subject.title: feat(channels): add pre-auth access requests and grouped DM allowlists

question: Should OpenClaw accept this pre-auth access-request design, including blocked-DM content exposure to trusted hooks, grouped DM allowlist config/CLI behavior, and dmPolicy-driven trusted hook auto-loading?
rationale: The PR defines new security, plugin, config, CLI, and operator defaults that automation cannot approve from code shape alone.

options.title: Security-Review Current Design
options.body: Keep the PR open and merge only after maintainers approve the pre-auth content payload, grouped allowlist contract, and trusted auto-load behavior.

options.title: Require Narrower Opt-In
options.body: Ask the author to make pre-auth payloads or access-request auto-loading more explicitly opt-in before exposing the contract.

options.title: Split The PR
options.body: Separate the hook primitive, grouped allowlists, CLI grouping, and auto-load behavior so each contract can be reviewed independently.

recommendation.title: Security-Review Current Design
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open and merge only after maintainers approve the pre-auth content payload, grouped allowlist contract, and trusted auto-load behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision centers on plugin hook contracts and trusted hook boundaries where local history shows repeated ownership signals.
